scientific_integrity: The exact mathematical theorem is proved under declared conditional Poisson and OR-rule assumptions; numerical checks are supplementary rather than formal proof; all claims concern the stated idealization.
scientific_limitations: Known fixed positive modal true-call and false-call intensities
Conditional independence and fixed target state
Divisible effort with common unit cost and an any-positive-count decision rule
Population Youden objective; not abundance estimation or prevalence-weighted risk
Historical priority not independently established and no empirical calibration supplied
title: An exact budget staircase for Poisson alarm detectors with false positives
